## 4.2.9 (HexGhoul): the Steel Blade's flash and finisher, the final kakuja's mask in the armor's colours

HexKagune 4.2.9 for Forge 1.20.1. Not tested in game. Protocol 131 (was 129): update the server and every player together.

You said (quoted exactly): "the mask is meant to be the same color as the armor"; "Blade Arm Control + right click (does a high speed dash,
only leaving behind after images)", then "Just make it like the new right click instead of right click dashing. We just have that move
instead."; and the finisher: "a kill stuns them 2 seconds while a shallow wound grows round their waist; when it meets its start the top half
slides off and falls face forward, blood everywhere", worked out with you to "Up more around here, the hands/arms get chopped off too and land
on the floor (the entire thing is meant to be an adaptive ragdoll that adapts to any terrain, can roll, etc.", "just make a really thin red
(bright and glowing) line around the whole area of the cut", "the line should honestly now start in the very center, and the line flows from
both sides at once", "the cut height is a fixed thing".

**The final kakuja's mask** is the armor's own navy plating now (it was black): lit blue-grey where it faces forward and up, a pale crest down
its beak, in your kagune colour like the chest.

**The Steel Blade's right click is the flash** (it was a dash): you're thrown about ten blocks in a fifth of a second, unseen and untouchable,
leaving only afterimages a body apart, the blade on them; whatever you pass through takes one Steel Blade cut. No Ctrl needed.

**The Steel Blade's finisher**: a kill of the blade's (its cuts, the flash) holds the body two seconds: it can't move, strike, use its
kagune, a quinque, a kakuja, regeneration or an item, and nothing else can hurt it, while a thin glowing red line draws itself across its
chest and both arms from the middle, both ways at once. When the ends meet it's cut apart there: the top (head, chest, upper arms) thrown
forward onto its face, both forearms with the hands dropping, the legs left standing; every piece in its own skin with what's inside on the
cut (a person's guts, spine and bone, a mob's red meat), falling as a ragdoll on whatever blocks are there (slopes, steps, walls), blood
thrown out of every cut and pooling. No death animation; the pieces lie 40 seconds, then fade. A Rinkaku's or Bikaku's kagune shatters. A
zombie keeps its own pose (arms held out above the cut stay on its top half). Named NPCs, children, the White Reaper and bosses too big for it
die as they always did; mobs not built like a person get the line and the blood, then their own death.

**Still to come:** an Ukaku's wings going down with the top half; any mob cut at a random angle through its own body (big modded ones too);
the Ukaku mastered transformation as an evil laugh; wider, more violent wing M1s and M2s.
